proposals.title: Reincorporate with Deeper Purpose
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend articles and bylaws to become a Social Purpose Corporation with specific social purposes benefiting employees, communities, and the environment.
proposals.evidence: For all of the reasons above, the Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 5

proposals.title: Transparency Reports
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to revise Transparency Reports to explain the number and categories of government-requested app removals that may limit freedom of expression or access to information.
proposals.evidence: For all of the reasons above, the Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 6.

proposals.title: Report on Forced Labor
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to oversee a report on how Apple's policies effectively protect supply chain workers from forced labor, including supplier risk and grievance mechanisms.
proposals.evidence: For all of the reasons above, the Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 7.

proposals.title: Pay Equity
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on median pay gaps across race and gender, including associated risks and risks related to recruiting and retaining diverse talent.
proposals.evidence: For all of the reasons above, the Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 8.

proposals.title: Civil Rights Audit
proposals.topic_summary: Urges a third-party audit of the adverse impact of Apple's policies and practices on the civil rights of company stakeholders, with recommendations.
proposals.evidence: For all of the reasons above, the Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 9.

proposals.title: Report on Concealment Clauses
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to prepare a public report assessing risks from concealment clauses in employment agreements related to harassment, discrimination, and unlawful acts.
proposals.evidence: For all of the reasons above, the Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 10.
